text: Error is not actionable (guess point #2): talk_send {to:'general'} (no #) -> 'blad: nie ma aktora general'; the agent is told a non-existent actor, not that an address must start with # or @ (fix: 'address must be #channel, @handle or @a,@b'). Related cosmetic: POST /api/conversations {kind:dm, members:['@ghost']} -> 'nie ma aktora @@ghost' (double @). Everything else I hit (409 konflikt_wiki, 409 lease heldBy, handle_zajety, brak_target, zly_target, juz_zamkniete) names the next step.
